news.title: ACME Solar shares rally 5% after Q2 profit jumps over 100%, signs 400MV agreement with NTPC
news.summary: ACME Solar shares rose 5% after its Q2 FY27 profit surged 133.5% to ₹269 crore and revenue climbed 67.5% to ₹1,007 crore. The rally was also supported by its subsidiary signing a 25-year power purchase agreement with NTPC for a 400 MW renewable energy project.

news.title: Global Market: China stocks fall as tech selloff deepens despite Fed rate pause
news.summary: Chinese stocks declined as a sharp selloff in technology and AI-related shares outweighed the US Federal Reserve’s decision to keep interest rates unchanged. The Shanghai Composite fell 0.9%, while the CSI300 dropped 1.2% and the STAR50 tumbled 4.2%.

news.title: HUL shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Jefferies, Nomura cut target price but forecast 29% upside potential
news.summary: Hindustan Unilever shares rose on Thursday after the FMCG major reported a 4% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 2,790 crore and 15% revenue growth to Rs 18,226 crore. Jefferies, Nomura and JM Financial cut their target prices but continue to see upside potential of up to 29%.

news.title: Global Market: ECB rate decision in focus as Lagarde exit speculation grows
news.summary: The European Central Bank is expected to hold interest rates steady as oil-driven inflation risks, rising French borrowing costs and uncertainty over President Christine Lagarde's future complicate the central bank's monetary policy outlook.

news.title: HUL’s revenue growth has a party pooper, and it’s may be here to stay
news.summary: Rising commodity prices squeezed HUL’s margins to multi-quarter lows in Q2, dampening investor sentiment despite revenue growth hitting a 14-quarter high.

news.title: Stockbrokers to seek Sebi clarity on peak margin after EPI relief
news.summary: On 22 October, Sebi eased margin requirements for trades made using proceeds from shares sold through the EPI mechanism. EPI allows investors to transfer shares to the clearing corporation before the usual settlement deadline.

news.title: Oil and gas stocks to buy: ONGC vs Oil India shares - Kotak Securities raises FY27 forecast to $100; know preferred pick
news.summary: Kotak raised its FY27 crude assumption to $100 per barrel amid supply risks and lifted earnings estimates for ONGC and Oil India. ONGC remains its preferred stock, with a 57% implied upside to its ₹360 fair value; Oil India’s ₹365 fair value implies about 20% downside.
